query: California Department of Public Health West Nile virus 2024 cases deaths statistics site:cdph.ca.gov
query_rationale: CDPH is the primary authoritative source for statewide WNV surveillance in California. Targeting the cdph.ca.gov domain directly maximizes the chance of retrieving the official 2024 WNV statistical report or weekly update page, which will contain confirmed/probable case counts, deaths, hospitalizations, and county-level breakdowns. This is the highest-value query for all target fields.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: CDPH WNV surveillance statistics page or annual/weekly report PDF listing case counts by county and week for 2024
expected_trust_signal: Official California state health agency domain (cdph.ca.gov); tabular case/death data with county breakdown

query: CDC ArboNET West Nile virus California 2024 human cases deaths neuroinvasive site:cdc.gov
query_rationale: CDC ArboNET is the national arboviral surveillance system and the definitive structured database for WNV human case counts in the US, including California. The CDC WNV data page publishes state-level confirmed neuroinvasive and non-neuroinvasive case counts and deaths by year. This cross-validates CDPH data and may provide case classification breakdowns (confirmed vs. probable) not always visible in state reports.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: CDC WNV data summary table or ArboNET report for 2024 with California row showing neuroinvasive/non-neuroinvasive cases and deaths
expected_trust_signal: Official US federal health agency domain (cdc.gov); ArboNET system attribution; tabular state-level data

query: West Nile virus California county August 2024 cases confirmed deaths public health department
query_rationale: California WNV reporting is also conducted at the county level (e.g., Los Angeles County DPH, Sacramento County, Kern County), which are the primary sources for locality-level data. This broader web search targets county health department pages and press releases reporting WNV cases in August 2024, enabling population of the 'locality' field and capturing sub-state geographic granularity not always present in state-level summaries.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: County public health department press releases, advisories, or surveillance updates mentioning specific WNV case counts and deaths in August 2024
expected_trust_signal: County health department domain (e.g., publichealth.lacounty.gov, sacpublichealth.net, kernpublichealth.com); official press release format with case counts

query: West Nile virus California August 2024 death cases reported outbreak
query_rationale: News sources often report WNV deaths and case milestones in near-real-time, citing official health department figures. A news search for August 2024 California WNV activity will surface evidence quotes, specific dates of reporting, and locality names that can be cross-referenced against official sources. This is especially valuable for the 'evidence_quote' and 'date_reported' fields and for identifying which counties had notable activity during the target window.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: News articles from regional California outlets (e.g., Sacramento Bee, LA Times, Fresno Bee) or wire services (AP, Reuters) reporting WNV cases or deaths in California in August 2024, citing health department data
expected_trust_signal: Dateline within August 2024; explicit citation of CDPH or county health department figures; named journalist byline

query_rationale: The CDC ArboNET historic data page was returned in iteration 1 but only as a navigation/landing page. The CDC also maintains a separate '2024 West Nile Virus Activity in the United States' current-season page that publishes weekly updated state-level case counts and deaths during the active surveillance season (typically May–November). This page would provide federal-level cross-validation of California case counts for August 2024 and may include neuroinvasive/non-neuroinvasive breakdowns. Targeting cdc.gov with current-season terminology distinguishes this from the historic data page already returned.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: CDC WNV 2024 current season activity page or weekly map/table showing California case counts and deaths by week or cumulative through August 2024
expected_trust_signal: cdc.gov domain; ArboNET attribution; state-level tabular data with California row; 2024 season labeling
